![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Since the wrapper is now written as CommonJS, we no longer need to write `package.json` into the shared `.git/hooks` directory.

```suggestion
    fs.mkdirSync(paths.hooksDir, { recursive: true });
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Using `--path-format=absolute` requires Git 2.31+. To support older Git versions, we can run `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` and resolve it relative to `repo_root` if it is a relative path.

```suggestion
git_common_dir="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)"
if [[ ! "$git_common_dir" = /* ]]; then
  git_common_dir="$repo_root/$git_common_dir"
fi
```

Fixed in `7ecb58d7a`: generated `.git/hooks/pre-commit` and `.git/hooks/pre-push` wrappers are now CommonJS (`require(...)`) and wrap the trusted-runtime dynamic `import(pathToFileURL(runtimePath).href)` in an async IIFE. The wrappers still import the trusted runtime snapshot from `.git/ciecopilot-hooks/guardrails.js` and verify SHA256 before execution.

Fixed in `7ecb58d7a`: removed the `package.json` write into the shared `.git/hooks` directory. The installer now only creates the hook wrapper files there; the ESM `package.json` marker remains limited to the isolated `.git/ciecopilot-hooks` runtime directory. Added regression coverage asserting `.git/hooks/package.json` is not written.

Fixed in `7ecb58d7a`: `install-trusted-hooks.js` now uses `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` with `shell: false` and resolves relative output against `repoRoot`. Added regression coverage for relative `.git` common-dir resolution and for avoiding `--path-format=absolute`.
Fixed in `7ecb58d7a`: `scripts/ao/start-clean.sh` now uses `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` and resolves a relative result against `repo_root`, while preserving the trusted hooks dir/runtime checks.
